title: Golden Axe: The Revenge of Death Adder (US, Rev A)
mra: references/s32/releases/Golden Axe The Revenge of Death Adder.mra
mra_note: upstream's MRA is the World set (ga2); ga2u runs on the same board, so the descriptor bytes are the same
input_profile_note: 0 = GA2 US wiring: Coin 1 on 8255 port C bit 3 (MAME ga2u counts SERVICE12 bit 2 as COIN4), Start on SERVICE12 bit 4
expected_sums_source: GA2Play8 d2_core_top_sp.sv parameters EXP_SUM0..EXP_FL2 (checksums of the slot files, not ROM data)
coin_chute_note: COIN ASSIGNMENTS > COIN CHUTE TYPE is EEPROM word 8 bit 0 (0 = COMMON, 1 = INDIVIDUAL); CABINET TYPE is word 7 bits 15:8 (0 = 2P, 1 = 3P, 2 = 4P). Measured 2026-11-25 by changing each setting in the game's own test menu and diffing the saved EEPROM (factory: World / Japan 2P COMMON, US 4P INDIVIDUAL); the same program in all three regions. The core routes the coin inputs from this bit, so the coin slots follow the setting the operator chose
cabinet_note: GAME ASSIGNMENTS > CABINET TYPE is EEPROM word 7 bits 9:8 (0 = 2P, 1 = 3P, 2 = 4P; menu-written saves, all three regions). With INDIVIDUAL chutes the game counts its coin lines (8255 PC b3, PC b2, SERVICE12 b3, SERVICE12 b2) by cabinet type: an N-player cabinet counts the last N for players 1..N (measured 2026-11-26, rel_derive.py CB); the core reads this field to route the coins
